dedupe_keys.name: indicadores de confiabilidade da rede basica ciper carga interrompida por perturbacoes

description: ONS publishes CIPER counts of disturbances grouped by the proportion of load interrupted. The dictionary defines successive twenty-percentage-point bands, with reporting geography and monthly or annual period. These counts support electricity-service disturbance and resilience studies. They describe severity bands and frequencies, not a time-resolved event log or a direct estimate of energy not supplied. The latter is a different ONS indicator. Coverage is SIN, subsystems, geographic regions and states in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV, Excel and Parquet files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS generation-by-plant data provide a comparison series.
